messages:
sam (AE): NovaBank dropped an updated security questionnaire with three hard asks: 1) BYOK with vendor-signed HSM attestation, 2) key rotation SLA (max 1hr window), 3) emergency rollback procedure with RTO <= 15m. They want these in the SOW. Can SE/SRE/security confirm?

rita (SE): Quick read: BYOK + attestation = fine. For rotation SLA 1hr we need to define what "window" means: key material rotation itself is instant, but cache TTLs and KV prefix caching will make a perceived cutover. If they expect all in-flight tokens to be rewrapped within 1hr, that's doable with an aggressive cache drain strategy. We'll need to disable long TTLs for the PO C.

omar (SRE): To hit RTO <=15m for emergency key rollback we need active traceability and a hot fallback key that we can switch to atomically. Practically: 1) pre-provision fallback KEK, 2) route new wrap ops to fallback, 3) progressively rewrap live prefixes. That will meet 15m for request routing, but full rewrap of backlog depends on volume. Also network latency to external HSM affects time. Recommend Dedicated + co-located proxy for the POC.

nina (Security): Attestation: we can provide vendor-signed cert and sanitized attestation report for POC. Full key-ceremony support requires a vendor schedule (usually 48-72h). For the 1hr rotation SLA, we must document limits and require client-side TTLs <= 60s for cached wrapped keys, otherwise they can't guarantee rewrap within SLA. Also callout: legal wants split-key (M-of-N) in contract language.

sam (AE): Procurement pushed: they will not accept any network-induced >20ms p95 for keywrap. They flagged our earlier numbers as too loose. Can SE/SRE provide a short perf statement for the SOW?

rita (SE): Perf statement: Dedicated + single hop key-proxy in same AZ: typical p95 10-18ms for AES wrap at 4k payloads; external cloud HSM peering adds ~20-40ms variability. I'll attach synthetic run numbers. Caveat: multi-region failover can increase latency.

lee (CSM): NovaBank wants a 10-business-day POC with two phases: phase 1 functional (attestation-sanitized), phase 2 live ceremony. They want daily checkpoint reports on latency and rotation tests. Can we commit?

omar (SRE): We can commit to the two-week slot. For the 10-day POC, I'll reserve 2-node Dedicated for phase 1 and hold an extra day for vendor ceremony in phase 2. Need IAM + peering by day -3.

nina (Security): I'll prepare a redacted attestation sample and a rotation playbook with exact steps, roles, and SLAs. Also a fallback runbook for emergency rollback.

sam (AE): Pricing ask: they want an itemized estimate: 1) Dedicated reserve delta, 2) per-ceremony flat fee, 3) per-KMS-op charge, 4) support SOW line for <15m rollback. Matt-like structure. Who owns?

rita (SE): I'll draft the technical annex for the SOW with perf numbers, rotation limits, and cache tuning recommendations.

omar (SRE): I'll post a short network checklist and the prometheus/grafana links for the demo dashboards once provisioned. Tag me with NovaBank IAM details.

sam (AE): Ok team — target deliverables by EOD Fri: 1) redacted attestation (Security), 2) harness + perf numbers (SE), 3) Dedicated reservation + dashboard (SRE), 4) pricing line items (AE). I'll coordinate kickoff with NovaBank once we have those. :thumbsup:
